workarounds.symptom: Pack install reports success when safety-kernel silently rejects the policy fragment
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(gateway): pack install validates policy fragments against kernel schema (closes the silent split-brain). Target files: core/controlplane/gateway/handlers_packs.go, core/controlplane/gateway/packs_test.go. `cordumctl pack install` reports `(ACTIVE)`, `GET /api/v1/policy/rules` happily returns the rules — but the safety-kernel logs `ERROR skipping malformed policy fragment` on every reload and evaluates with **zero rules from the fragment**. Every subsequent job hits `decision=DENY rule_id="" reason="no matching rule — def... (Ref: https://github.com/cordum-io/cordum/pull/317)

workarounds.symptom: fix(dashboard): add error handling for chat send mutation
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dashboard): surface chat send errors to user (#168). Target files: dashboard/src/pages/RunDetailPage.test.ts, .env.example, dashboard/src/pages/RunDetailPage.tsx. \`chatMutation\` in \`RunDetailPage.tsx\` had no \`onError\` handler. A failed send (403, 500, network error) cleared the input silently and left the user with no feedback that anything went wrong. This mirrors the load-side gap that #166 closed on the load path. (Ref: https://github.com/cordum-io/cordum/pull/196)
